Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly applied the physics of blackbody radiation. It stated that "hotter objects emit light with shorter wavelengths (blue end)" which is correct, but then concluded that "blue is coolest" and "red is hottest". This is a direct contradiction of its own premise and the actual physics: Blue light has a shorter wavelength (~450-495 nm) and higher frequency/energy, corresponding to higher temperatures, while Red light has a longer wavelength (~620-750 nm) and lower energy, corresponding to lower temperatures. Therefore, the order from highest to lowest temperature should be Blue (Object 1) > Orange (Object 3) > Red (Object 2). The Planner reversed the relationship between color/wavelength and temperature, leading to the wrong final answer (B instead of the correct sequence starting with Object 1).
